author: Fleeq
name: StatusMonitor
short: One live embed tracking the status of your services.
description: Monitor links or host:port services and keep a single embed updated every minute with a per-service status bar built from the last checks. Configurable channel, mentioned roles, colour, title, interval and history length.
install_msg:
Thanks for installing StatusMonitor!

Set it up with:
1. `[p]statusmon channel #status`
2. `[p]statusmon add "My API" https://api.example.com/health`
3. `[p]statusmon roles @Ops` (optional)
4. `[p]statusmon color #00b894` (optional)

The panel then updates itself every minute.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores server configuration (channel, roles, colour) and the reachability history of the services an administrator adds. It stores no personal data about end users.
